jobs.title: Technical Implementation Consultant, EHS (EMEA)
jobs.description:
About HSI

HSI is a leading provider of EHS, compliance, and workforce development solutions. Through our Donesafe platform, we help organisations simplify safety, streamline processes, and strengthen workplace cultures.
As our EMEA presence grows, we're looking for a technically minded, customer-focused Implementation Consultant to join our expanding team.
About the Role

This is a hands-on implementation role where you'll own the full customer onboarding journey, from initial kick-off through configuration, testing, and go-live. You'll be the single point of contact for your clients, managing every stage of delivery to ensure successful adoption of HSI's Donesafe solution.
You won't be handing tasks to a delivery team. You'll be the principle technical resource, delivering the implementation, while building strong client relationships, and ensuring every project runs on time and to scope
We're seeking an experienced Implementation professional who combines industry knowledge with technical proficiency and exceptional client engagement skills.
The ideal candidate brings:
Exceptional communication and presentation skills
Strong analytical and technical capabilities
Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences
A proactive, solution-oriented mindset to anticipate challenges
Adaptability and meticulous attention to detail
Great listening skills. Requirement gathering is a key part of the role so the ability to ask the right questions and correctly understand the information received is essential 

What You'll Do

Lead client onboarding sessions, guiding customers through the implementation journey and setting clear expectations.
Run discovery workshops to gather and define customer requirements within the agreed scope.
Own end-to-end delivery, managing your project plan in Rocketlane and keeping work on time, in scope, and within budget.
Build, configure and document solutions in the HSI Donesafe platform, translating technical requirements into effective workflows and automations. 
Support data migration from legacy systems and ensure smooth integration.
Deliver client training and create clear user documentation for administrators and end users.
Test and validate configurations internally and with clients to meet quality and functional requirements.
Lead go-live activities and coordinate a seamless handover to Support.
Manage risks proactively, communicating and resolving issues early to keep projects on track.
Close projects confidently, finalising deliverables and supporting the transition to Customer Success.
Continuously improve by identifying opportunities to enhance implementation quality and customer experience.
Collaborate occasionally with Product or APAC teams on technical discussions or complex projects, with 2 to 5 hours per week of flexibility.

Requirements

3+ years of experience delivering end-to-end software implementations within a SaaS environment.
Background or familiarity with the EHS or Health and Safety industry is highly desirable.
Proven experience configuring workflows, forms, and automations within software platforms or similar configuration-based systems.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to lead workshops and explain technical details clearly to non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality.
A customer-first mindset, focused on creating a positive experience and measurable value for every client.
Proactive and solution-oriented, with the judgement to make sound decisions and resolve challenges early.
Adaptable and detail-focused, with the ability to work comfortably in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Collaborative when needed, with the ability to partner with Product or global teams while working independently day to day.
Degree in IT, Business, EHS, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

Benefits

Bupa (UK) and Layla (Ireland) Private Health Insurance & Rewards
Hybrid and flexible working
Enhanced family leave benefits
Tuition assistance and professional development funding
Your birthday off every year
25+ days annual leave, increasing with service
Mental health and wellbeing support through Wisdom EAP
A collaborative culture with regular team events

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About

Propeller is on a mission to take the guesswork out of moving dirt - reducing wasted fuel, time, and money. We do this through the power of maps.

Our customers use Propeller's integrated hardware and software products to capture accurate 3D versions of their worksites. With over 50,000 worksites worldwide using Propeller's smart survey technology, we empower project teams to map, measure, and manage site activity.

Propeller empowers everyone to approach, own, and solve problems creatively. We're data nerds who care about impact, honesty, and each other. We take pride in being a great place to work. We are proud to be recipients of BI Group's Excellence in Customer Experience award and Inspiring Workplaces of Australasia, being recognized as a Fast Company and BuiltIn Best Place to Work. You can learn more about us on Glassdoor.

Your Mission

Empower our customers to maximize the value from our product, turning successful adoption into lasting partnerships. The Customer Success Manager
will be the primary driver of this success, directly impacting revenue retention by proactively ensuring customer health and satisfaction, and fostering account growth through identifying and realizing upsell and expansion opportunities. Ultimately, you will be key to transforming customer relationships into a powerful engine for mutual growth and sustainable business success.

Your Responsibilities

Customer Lifecycle & Adoption:

Serve as the primary relationship owner, guiding customers through adoption, expansion, and renewal
Drive engagement by ensuring customers effectively leverage Propeller's platform and tools (platform workflows, 3D mapping, GIS integrations, site/stockpile measurements, progress reporting, mobile app use cases, DirtMate adoption)
Proactively educate customers on new features, under-utilized tools, and product updates to increase adoption and impact
Manage and own product roadmap reviews with customers to align on goals, showcase value, and identify opportunities for continued partnership
Act as a trusted advisor by maintaining strong industry and product knowledge, helping customers translate data into meaningful business outcomes

Retention & Value Delivery:

Maintain strong customer relationships that ensure high adoption, satisfaction, and measurable ROI
Proactively identify risks and mitigate churn and contraction through data-driven insights and engagement
Track customer health (logins, uploads, feature usage) to ensure customers are on track with their license entitlements
Ensure customers achieve their stated goals and business outcomes, adjusting engagement strategies as needed
Maintain 90%+ Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) across your portfolio

Commercial Growth & Account Management:

Own net expansions, comprised of renewals, expansions, and upsells, in addition to churn and contraction mitigation
Identify, develop, and close commercial opportunities within existing accounts in partnership with channel partners and dealers, where applicable
Negotiate renewals and contract terms, demonstrating clear ROI and value
Educate customers on pricing changes, new product offerings, and value-added solutions
Build and maintain strategic relationships with decision-makers, aligning Propeller solutions to evolving customer needs

Collaboration & Reporting:

Track and manage customer activities, risks, and opportunities using Gainsight
Lead business reviews with customers to demonstrate value, ROI, and strategic alignment
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support to represent customer needs, provide feedback, and help improve the product experience
Support team-wide goals, process improvements, and documentation to scale customer success and commercial impact

Requirements

Your Skills

Commercial Acumen: the ability to build compelling, ROI-driven business cases and align technology solutions with customer goals in a B2B SaaS environment
Strategic Account Growth: the ability to act as a trusted thought partner, helping customers maximize value from Propeller while identifying opportunities for expansion
Customer Relationship Management: skilled in managing a portfolio of customers — driving adoption, preventing churn, and delivering measurable business outcomes
Technologically Adept: technically curious and comfortable learning and applying new tools or platforms (experience with GIS, mapping, or data technology a plus)
Excellent Communication Skills: strong relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills
Data-driven: proactive, using insights to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for customer growth

Not required but bonus points if you have:

Experience in GIS, mapping, construction technology, or drone surveying
Knowledge of UAVs, GPS surveying, photogrammetry, machine control, or visualization platforms
Experience with CRM tools such as Gainsight and/or Hubspot

We operate on a hybrid model (two days a week in the office), but we ask for four days in-office during your onboarding period to give you the best possible training and support.

Propeller is for everyone, so come as you are. We value all types of experience, skill, and ability. If you don't think you meet all the requirements, but still think this role would be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity makes our team more creative, fun, and effective, so bring your whole self to the application process, and we will too! If you're interested in what life at Propeller is like, check out our employee-owned Medium blog page!

Benefits

Employee share options
Professional development budget and leave
The opportunity to take part in our mentorship program
Mental health resources
Monthly telephone and/or internet allowance
Paid primary & secondary parental leave policies
Hybrid work arrangements and WFH equipment provided

The salary range offered for this role is $70,000-$80,000 (base) + $15,000 - $25,000 (variable), which equals $85,000 - $105,000 (OTE). This range is tied to the market for this job in Colorado. Any salary offer extended will be based on skills, knowledge and experience.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
Bitsight is a cyber risk management leader transforming how companies manage exposure, performance, and risk for themselves and their third parties. Companies rely on Bitsight to prioritize their cybersecurity investments, build greater trust within their ecosystem, and reduce their chances of financial loss.

Built on over a decade of technological innovation, its integrated solutions deliver value across enterprise security performance, digital supply chains, cyber insurance, and data analysis.

We invented the cyber ratings industry in 2011
Over 3500 customers trust Bitsight
Over 600 teammates are dispersed throughout Boston, Raleigh, New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and remote

About The Role

The Strategic Partnerships Customer Success Manager is a senior business operator with a strategic vision, responsible for owning the post-sale success, value adoption, expansion, and retention of Bitsight's most strategic customer accounts; including OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers), and Insurance use cases.

Unlike traditional CSM roles, this position emphasizes partner enablement, integration success, operational data scalability, and commercial alignment. You will serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the C-suite and executive leadership at partners who utilize, embed, resell, or operationalize Bitsight capabilities within their own offerings and service delivery models.

This is a role with significant strategic influence in our business. You will own a high-value portfolio (50-80 accounts), responsible for driving measurable success, deployment, adoption maturity, expansion revenue, and long-term retention. You will be accountable for improving net revenue retention, identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities, and positioning critical partnerships for predictable, scalable growth. Beyond your individual portfolio, you will shape and lead the strategic partnerships customer success function, mentor team members, and influence company-wide partner strategy.

This role is ideal for a person with sophisticated strategic judgment who combines deep technical and domain expertise with executive-level relationship management, commercial acumen, and organizational influence. You'll thrive at the intersection of customer success, strategic partnerships, solutions consulting, and revenue acceleration. You will have the autonomy to drive transformational partnerships and the future of how Bitsight scales with strategic partners. If you are hired near one of our offices, 3 days of in-office work is required, if not we also support hybrid/remote working models.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account & Revenue Leadership

Own post-sales success for a portfolio of the company's strategic and high-revenue OEM, and insurance customers, with direct accountability for NRR improvement, expansion revenue targets, and retention of critical accounts
Serve as the primary executive point of contact and trusted strategic advisor to the partner C-suite, executive leadership, product management, engineering, research and operations teams
Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year partner success strategies aligned to executive buyers business objectives, value realization metrics, competitive positioning, and growth targets
Own the qualification of expansion: identify, evangelize, structure, and partner with sales on high-value expansion opportunities including driven by signals such as; usage, new modules, adjacent solutions, vertical expansion, and strategic initiatives
Lead executive business reviews and strategic partnership planning sessions, presenting adoption metrics, value realization, competitive benchmarking, roadmap alignment, and renewal/expansion readiness to C-level executives. This role will require some travel to visit customers onsite.
Ensure consistent, predictable revenue retention and growth within the strategic partnership portfolio; drive partner satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS)

Strategic Partnerships & Organizational Leadership

Shape and evolve the customer success strategy and playbooks for strategic partnerships, establishing customer defined goals and maturity; best practices, frameworks, and scalable processes that other CSMs and teams can leverage
Mentor and develop CSMs and account management team members on strategic partnership management, executive engagement, and relationship dynamics
Serve as a voice of strategic partner customers within the organization; influence product roadmap, feature prioritization, business and technical strategy based on partner feedback and market positioning
Collaborate with the CRO, VP and Director of Customer Success to define KPIs, success metrics, and organizational priorities for the strategic partnerships segment
Contribute to cross-functional strategy sessions on partner ecosystem development, GTM alignment, and long-term partnership growth strategy

Partner Enablement & Integration

Align closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and Support teams to ensure seamless integration and implementation of Bitsight capabilities into partner platforms and workflows
Advise partners on API-based integrations, data feeds, platform configurations, and operational scalability requirements specific to their OEM, or insurance models
Develop best-practice guidance on value goals, maturity, workflows, SLAs, success metrics, and competitive positioning tied to Bitsight-powered offerings
Deliver partner-focused training, enablement content, digital touchpoints and certification programs for partner teams and personas
Serve as a liaison between partners and Bitsight technical teams, advocating for needs, identifying gaps, managing expectations and contributing to product roadmap alignment

Adoption & Value Realization

Conduct value discovery workshops to align capabilities with partner strategies, workflows, objectives, and models
Proactively monitor partner health signals, adoption milestones, NPS/CSAT, product usage trends, and time-to-value metrics to identify risk, drive adoption, and accelerate ROI
Guide partners through advanced product configuration, threat data operationalization, and integration decisions with their existing security infrastructure
Present adoption metrics, usage insights, and risk assessments to internal and external stakeholders, demonstrating platform effectiveness and value delivery
Identify expansion pathways across increased coverage, advanced modules, add-ons, and cross-sell opportunities within partner customer bases

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

Work with Sales to drive high renewal rates, expansion of ACV, and partnership customer business evolution
Lead risk mitigation strategies and renewal planning to ensure proactive engagement and strong expansion narratives
Contribute 10%+ of time to scalable CS processes and playbooks that support repeatable partner success and predictable revenue performance
Leverage operations tools (Claude, Gainsight, Salesforce, Pendo and related CS tooling) to deliver data-driven, scalable partner engagement
Champion the partner's voice internally, advocating for their needs and identifying systemic improvements to support partner growth

Requirements

Experience & Background

Post-sales or customer success experience including Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, or Program Management in SaaS or software partnership environments
Proven track record managing large portfolios (80+ accounts) of enterprise, strategic, or high-revenue partner accounts with direct accountability for revenue retention, expansion, and NRR improvement
Direct experience supporting OEM, MSSP, ISV, platform, or integration-driven customers; experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, risk management, or insurance technology platforms is preferred
Demonstrated expertise building and managing complex, C-suite level relationships across matrixed organizations; proven ability to influence executive decision-making and drive strategic alignment
Experience leading or contributing to scalable CS strategy, process design, or organizational best practices; track record of mentoring and developing teams is a plus
Background in insurance software, managed services, platform distribution models, or enterprise security software is highly valued

Technical & Domain Expertise

Strong technical aptitude with practical understanding of APIs, integrations, data feeds, and complex platform configurations
Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts, threat intelligence workflows, managed detection and response (MDR), SIEM/SOAR platforms, or risk management frameworks
Experience advising on and supporting integrations across enterprise security ecosystems (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, EDR, GRC, ticketing systems, threat intelligence platforms)
Comfort operating in technically sophisticated environments; ability to engage confidently with security practitioners, architects, and CISOs

Business & Relationship Skills

Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills; ability to influence and align stakeholders at all organizational levels
Strong business acumen with ability to translate technical requirements into business outcomes and commercial value
Proven ability to identify, analyze, and articulate expansion opportunities; understand commercial models, licensing, and partner margin dynamics
Demonstrated project management excellence, including managing multiple concurrent complex engagements, timelines, and stakeholder expectations
Consulting mindset with proven problem-solving, analytical, and strategic thinking capabilities

Belonging & Inclusion
.
Bitsight is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, or status as an individual with a disability.

Culture.
We put our people first. Bitsight offers best in class benefits. We devote the same energy to nurturing our company's inclusive culture as we apply to serving our customers' needs. Working at Bitsight will give you the opportunity to fulfill your professional goals and expand your skills.

Open-minded.
If you got to this point, we hope you’re feeling excited about the job description you just read. Even if you don’t feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We’re eager to meet people that believe in Bitsight’s mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways.

Bitsight also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or based on a sincerely held religious belief in accordance with applicable laws. If you need to inquire about a reasonable accommodation, or need assistance with completing the application process, please email recruiting@bitsight.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only, and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

This role uses AI-assisted transcription during the interview process. All hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team.

Additional Information for United States of America Applicants
:

Bitsight is committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Bitsight will not discharge, discipline or in any other manner discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because such employee or applicant has inquired about, discussed, or disclosed the compensation of the employee or applicant or another employee or applicant.

jobs.title: Associate Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Fullpath by Cox Automotive is a fast growing tech company in the automotive space with hubs across the US and Israel. We are disrupting the multi-trillion dollar transportation industry with our advanced Customer Data Platform (CDP) . Our work happens in the fast lane as we bring AI-powered, data-driven solutions to a quickly evolving industry.

Our team at Fullpath is made up of curious and creative individuals who are always looking to achieve the impossible. We are bold, collaborative, and goal driven, and, at our core, we believe every voice has value and can impact our bottom line.

If you are a creative, solutions oriented individual who is ready to put your career in drive, Fullpath is the place for you!

We’re looking for a driven, detail-oriented, and proactive Associate Customer Success Manager to support and scale our Customer Success efforts across enterprise accounts. In this role, you’ll play a key part in supporting campaign execution, managing operational workflows, solving problems, and partnering cross-functionally to drive results. You’ll work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where processes and priorities can evolve quickly, so the ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and find solutions without always having a defined path will be important. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is curious, eager to learn, comfortable taking on task-oriented work, and interested in building a long-term career in Customer Success with the potential to grow into a CSM role.

This is a remote position reporting to the Strategic Account Manager of Major Accounts.

What you will be responsible for:

Assisting the Customer Success team with the creation and execution of custom audience lists and campaigns, including digital advertising and email marketing campaigns.
Supporting the development and delivery of client-specific assets and reports, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Creating, customizing, and managing Dynamic Payments offers and other promotional materials as required.
Providing monthly support for co-op submissions.
Creating and managing inbound cases through a queue, ensuring requests are appropriately tracked and resolved.
Providing ongoing operational and task-based support for Fullpath’s Enterprise Customer Success team.
Collaborating cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure client requests and project deliverables are executed efficiently and to a high standard.
Supporting client communication when needed to fulfill assigned tasks and help ensure a positive customer experience.
Supporting strategic initiatives by helping manage project timelines, resources, and communications.
Monitoring and maintaining task workflows, escalating issues when needed and ensuring smooth handoffs within the Customer Success organization.
Identifying opportunities to improve existing processes, develop new workflows, and make day-to-day Customer Success operations more efficient.
Taking on additional account or customer support responsibilities as needed, including providing coverage when a CSM is unavailable.

Requirements:

Strong interest in building a career in Customer Success, with an interest in eventually growing into a Customer Success Manager role.
A proactive, curious, and self-directed approach to work, with a willingness to ask questions, learn independently, and find solutions when the path forward is not clearly defined.
Ability to operate effectively in an environment where processes, priorities, and responsibilities can change frequently.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of detailed, task-oriented work while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.
High level of competency working with data to support business decisions and customer outcomes.
Ability to build and implement follow-up processes and stay on top of multiple priorities.
Independent problem-solving skills and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with both internal teams and customers when needed.
Exposure to or interest in using AI tools to improve productivity, workflows, or day-to-day work.
Strong work ethic, ownership, and willingness to take on hands-on operational work as part of developing within Customer Success.
Automotive industry and/or digital advertising experience is a plus, but not required.
Legal authorization to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.
Ability to sit for extended periods and perform extensive computer work, both of which are key aspects of the role.
Ability to perform job duties from a home office, when applicable, utilizing necessary technology and maintaining productivity.
Regular, reliable attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the job to ensure consistent workflow and communication.

Why you should join us:

At Fullpath, we’re not just building groundbreaking AI—we’re redefining the dealership experience. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact while working alongside passionate, forward-thinking individuals who love what they do.

Competitive compensation & comprehensive benefits—because your well-being matters
Flexible, family-friendly environment that supports work-life balance
Global team of innovators, collaborators, and go-getters who challenge and uplift one another
Cutting-edge AI technology that delivers real value and solves complex challenges for our customers
Fast-paced startup culture with endless opportunities for learning, growth, and ownership
A culture built on feedback, initiative, and mutual success, where your voice is heard and your potential is nurtured

Join us in shaping the future of automotive retail—we’re just getting started.

Annual base salary: $65,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Benefits Options: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life/AD&D, EAP, 15 vacation days per year to start, 80 hours of sick leave, 12 paid holidays, paid parental leave, & 401k with company match.

In the meantime, you can get to know us a little better by checking out @lifeatfullpath on Instagram and Facebook .

jobs.title: EverPro - Customer Success Manager (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about-us/careers/

EverPro,
a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to focus on our MarketSharp product line within Customer Experience Solutions. MarketSharp helps home improvement and remodeling businesses manage leads, streamline sales and marketing workflows, strengthen customer relationships, and drive measurable growth through a purpose-built CRM platform.

The ideal candidate will serve as a day-to-day partner and trusted advisor to customers, with a primary focus on driving retention, strengthening customer relationships, and helping clients achieve continued value from the organization’s products and services. This role provides support, guidance, and product knowledge to ensure customers remain engaged, satisfied, and successful throughout the customer lifecycle.

The Customer Success Manager will proactively monitor customer health, identify retention risks, and address customer needs, challenges, and opportunities before they impact satisfaction or renewal outcomes. This individual will collect and respond to customer feedback, provide focused support and best-practice guidance, and help increase product adoption, engagement, and long-term value.

This role will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Support, Implementation, and other customer-facing teams to resolve issues, improve the customer experience, and support renewal goals. The Customer Success Manager will also act as the voice of the customer internally by sharing insights, product feedback, and recommendations that help improve retention, customer success, and continued customer growth.

Responsibilities:

Manage and grow relationships with a portfolio of customers, serving as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor for both the team and an owed book of business
Drive customer adoption, engagement, and long-term value from the CRM platform.
Monitor customer health, usage trends, and satisfaction to identify risks and opportunities.
Proactively address customer questions, concerns, and escalations in a timely and professional manner.
Partner with Sales, Support, Product, and Implementation teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
Identify opportunities for account growth, renewals, upsells, and expanded product usage.
Gather customer feedback and share insights with internal teams to improve the product and customer experience.
Maintain accurate account notes, activity records, and customer success plans in the CRM.
Support retention goals by increasing customer loyalty, reducing churn, and demonstrating measurable business impact.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

4+ years working in a B2B client-facing account management, support or project management role, preferably involving SaaS
Comfortable leveraging software tools, CRM, email marketing, support, automation, productivity, and presentation software.
Leverages data to determine when accounts require an “off-cycle” intervention to maintain health and retain value delivery goals.
Able to identify risks and opportunities and understands what actions to take in these scenarios.
Successfully identifies and catalogs champions within customer accounts.
Appropriately leverage internal channels to seek guidance on more difficult customer circumstances.
Keeps portfolio up to date and organized, ensures accurate reporting of CS engagements in Salesforce.
Data-driven decision maker, with urgency operating in a “test and learn” environment focused on meaningful and rapid process optimization.
Track record in driving customer engagement and loyalty.
Innovative thinking and bias for action balanced with a strong customer and quality focus.
Persuasive communicator with both clients and internal company teams and staff.
Intellectually robust and agile, with the ability to make quick decisions as needed.
Self-confidence matched with a willingness to collaborate and successfully engage with colleagues.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship management skills – deep cross- functional collaboration is required.
Preferred skills and experience: Zendesk customer support methods; Salesforce.

Where:
US Remote

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States– if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits And Perks

Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend

jobs.description:
Description

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.
Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.
At Realtor.com we are building products that empower millions of homebuyers, renters, and real estate professionals to navigate the journey of home ownership with confidence. As data sits at the heart of everything we do, protecting it is a strategic priority. In support of our journey to modernize for scale and innovation, we are seeking a SOX Compliance Analyst to lead our Sarbanes-Oxley compliance program across all Snowflake environments. This role sits within the Data Governance function and is critical to ensuring that our data infrastructure meets the highest standards of security, integrity, and regulatory accountability.
As our SOX Compliance Analyst, you will serve as the centralized point of contact for all SOX-related technical audit evidence, working closely with the Finance audit function, Data Governance, and engineering teams. You will own the end-to-end implementation of SOX controls within Snowflake, from identity and access management to change management, disaster recovery, and continuous monitoring, ensuring we achieve and maintain compliance across all Snowflake table sets.
Top reasons to apply:

Build a Cloud-Compliance Strategy from Scratch: You will have the unique career runway to architect and implement an enterprise-wide SOX compliance framework inside Snowflake from the ground up, moving the company past fragmented processes into a mature, modern data governance model.
Drive High-Impact Visibility as a Cross-Functional Enabler: This is not a siloed, checkbox compliance role. You will act as the central technical hub independently networking across Finance, Data Governance, Data Council, and Engineering teams to shield Realtor.com from audit risks while keeping product analytics fast and agile.

What you’ll do:

Lead the implementation and ongoing management of SOX compliance across all Snowflake instances, serving as the organization’s subject matter expert for data-layer SOX controls.
Maintain and enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) within Snowflake, ensuring all data access adheres to the principle of least privilege.
Conduct and manage periodic user access reviews as part of the broader identity and access governance program.
Establish and enforce segregation of duties through standardized testing and code deployment practices within the Data Governance framework.
Enable and maintain comprehensive auditing, logging, and monitoring capabilities across Snowflake environments.
Act as the centralized point of contact for all technical audit evidence, coordinating with both internal and external auditors to shorten the audit cycle and reduce external auditor fees.
Formalize and document change management processes for Snowflake to ensure controlled, traceable, and auditable modifications to data infrastructure.
Lead disaster recovery planning and testing for Snowflake, ensuring business continuity and data availability in the event of an incident.
Partner with the CCPA compliance program to support Observepoint pixel scans and ensure data collection practices remain compliant with domestic regulatory requirements.
Work within the Data Governance framework to align SOX controls with broader governance policies, standards, and the Data Council.
Contribute to making Snowflake the authoritative system of record by ensuring all compliance standards are embedded into data workflows from the ground up.

What you’ll bring:

4+ years of experience in compliance, data governance, or a related field, with at least 2 years of hands-on SOX compliance experience in a technology or data environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Strong working knowledge of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX), particularly IT General Controls (ITGCs) and their application to cloud-based data platforms.
Experience managing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and identity governance frameworks.
Familiarity with change management methodologies and the ability to formalize and enforce deployment standards within a data engineering or analytics environment.
Experience supporting internal and external audits, including gathering, organizing, and presenting technical audit evidence.
Understanding of data privacy regulations, including CCPA, and their intersection with SOX requirements.
Strong analytical and documentation skills, with the ability to translate complex compliance requirements into actionable technical controls.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, finance, legal, and business stakeholders.
Proficiency with SQL for data querying and evidence validation within cloud data warehouse environments.
Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Snowflake, including its native security and governance features (e.g., dynamic data masking, row access policies, query history).
Certification in compliance, audit, or information security (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CIA, CDMP, or equivalent).
Familiarity with AI/ML applications for compliance automation, including anomaly detection and PII identification tools.
Experience with data catalog tools (e.g., Acryl, Collibra, Alation) to support metadata management and compliance documentation.
Knowledge of Observepoint or similar pixel scanning tools for CCPA regulatory compliance.
Exposure to BI and monitoring tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) for compliance dashboarding and reporting.

How We Work:

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager (NHS)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Heim are powering the left shift, and forging the way for decentralisation of healthcare. Our team of technologists, clinicians, and operators design and deploy technology that unlocks frontline productivity - giving teams back the time to care.

We understand decentralised healthcare deeply. Our nurses deliver thousands of visits across the UK, whilst our technology supports over 20,000+ hours of NHS community operations. We build our technology from learnings from every patient encounter.

The Role

We are hiring a strategic Enterprise Customer Success Manager
to serve as the senior accountable lead for our most complex NHS system accounts in the UK. You will lead the full lifecycle of each NHS contract from pilot design through implementation, adoption, expansion, and renewal.

You will run large-scale deployments of Heim software inside the NHS and social care. These are the deployments the product learns from and long-term partnerships are built on. In your first two, your work will shape the working day of more than 800 nurses delivering close to a million patient contacts a year. We need someone there to get the technology in the hands of nurses quickly, grow the account, and prove the technology works and has real impact.

You are accountable for three outcomes:

Full contract value, at pace. Every contracted site, team and user live and using Heim, as fast as the partner can take it.
Growth in the contract and the product. You find where the partner can use more of Heim and where Heim should build next, and you act on both.
Evidence that holds up. Real-world evidence of the time given back to clinical care, strong enough to justify commissioning and renewal.

What You’ll Do

Realise full contract value at pace

Own each partner from contract mobilisation and governance kick-off through structured discovery, go-live and embedded business-as-usual use, with full contracted value as your headline target.
Run phased, multi-team rollouts to a plan built for speed. Track time to go-live and time to full adoption by cohort, and act when a cohort slips.
Own the DPIA support, data flow sign-off and information governance steps that gate NHS go-live, working with our Clinical Safety Officer and the Trust's governance leads.
Spot risks and blockers early, whether operational, clinical, technical or political, and have the mitigation ready before they reach the timeline or the relationship.
Be the face of Heim to the partner, trusted by both the ward and the board. Build relationships from frontline staff and super-users to the COO, Divisional Director and project sponsor, and run the weekly check-ins and monthly leadership reviews.
Coach teams through new ways of working, watch the usage data, and step in early where engagement dips or a team gets stuck.

Grow the contract and the product

Identify and execute expansion across sites, services and community teams. You own account growth with the commercial team and contribute directly to ACV, retention and NRR.
Arm champions inside the Trust to make the internal case for wider rollout, translating impact for the people who control budget, sequencing and expansion.
Work with the commercial team before signature. Scope NHS deployments, shape pilots, and design evaluation frameworks that turn into multi-year commissioning cases.
Treat every deployment as live co-design. Bring structured, prioritised feedback to Product and Engineering, and spot where Heim should build next, for example by extending Grace into further non-clinical touchpoints.
Manage expectations with care where capability is still being built or is pending regulatory approval such as MDR, keeping partners confident and well informed without over-promising.

Generate the evidence

Agree baselines with every partner at the start of a deployment, so that impact can be measured from day one.
Generate real-world evidence from deployment data on time given back to clinical care, admin reduced, drive time and mileage, working with our clinical and data colleagues to a standard that commissioners and clinical leaders will accept.
Turn that evidence into commissioning cases and renewal narratives, adjusted in depth and style for clinical, operational, IT and finance audiences. Don’t just present the insight, help them understand the story and what it means for them.
Own the return on investment story for each partner. Where the evidence is weak, you find out first and fix it.

Build the function, with AI at the core

Create the playbooks, deployment frameworks, governance packs, onboarding materials and health frameworks that make NHS implementation repeatable. This is what gets us to six live Trusts in the next 9 to 12 months.
Use AI in your own deployments, from reporting and insight to training materials and adoption tracking, and show the team how.
Set the standard as the function grows, and mentor the implementation hires who follow you.

What We’re Looking For

You grow accounts, prove value with data, and move quickly. You have done this in healthcare or a similarly complex or regulatory setting and you are from a start-up or scale-up background. We value pace of learning, so if you have grown fast and can show it, we want to hear from you whatever your years of experience.

Commercially sharp. You have grown enterprise accounts through expansion and renewal, and you can quote the numbers: ACV growth, retention, NRR. You can hold a commercial conversation on your own.
Evidence-led. You have built the case for adoption or commissioning from baselines, usage data and outcome data, and it stood up to scrutiny from finance and clinical leaders. You know what sits behind the numbers.
A deployment leader. You have led complex, multi-site implementation or transformation work, ideally delivering software into the NHS, and you know what gets clinical teams to adopt something new.
Fluent in the NHS and social care. You understand how decisions are made, who holds influence, and clinical safety and information governance in practice (DCB0129, DTAC, DPIA, MDR).
Executive in presence. You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still shaping the outcome. You have changed a senior stakeholder's mind, and you read complex organisations quickly without getting captured by one faction.
A builder. You can create process, structure and documentation from scratch while running a live, high-stakes programme.
AI fluent. You use AI tools daily, you keep pace with how fast they are moving, and you have ideas for how to apply them to deployments, reporting and adoption.
Calm and meticulous. The product is evolving, partners are co-designing it with us, and priorities shift. You bring order to that, with an exceptional eye for detail.

Above all, you care about this. The shift of healthcare into the home is happening, and the difference between a pilot and a partnership is usually the person leading it.

What do we believe in?

Heim builds for the future of healthcare. We believe in progress built through drive, dedication and ownership.

01 Take care:
Of our service, each other and, above all, our patients.

02 Challenge the status quo:
Healthcare has stayed unchanged for too long.

03 Build things you’d use:
Anything else isn’t good enough.

04 Be the teammate you’d want to have:
Show up, follow through and make the people around you better.

05 Win together:
We move fast, but never alone

Practical Requirements

Right to work: You must have the right to work in the UK. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
Driving Licence: A full UK driving licence is preferred. This role spends real time on partner sites, often in services that cover a wide geography.
Availability: We are looking for an immediate start ideally, in September or October. Please tell us your availability in your application.

Why You Should Join Heim 🚀

Solve real problems in healthcare: Help healthcare overcome the limitations of legacy technology.
Give time back to the frontline: Be part of a mission that gives community teams a third of their time back. You will help reduce the 40% of the day that field staff currently spend on administrative tasks and manual workarounds.
Deeply empathetic engineering: Build tools grounded in frontline reality - our technology has been shaped by shadowing over 20,000 hours of community staff time.
Address the issues that matter most: Work on software that directly targets the top concerns of frontline staff, including lone working safety, tiresome admin and repetitive tasks.
Drive measurable impact: Deliver optimization solutions that model a 42% average reduction in drive time and up to a 52% reduction in mileage for community teams.
Build cutting-edge, secure technology: Develop AI that automates non-clinical touchpoints while working within a highly secure, ISO27001 UKAS accredited and DCB0129 compliant framework.

What We Offer

Compensation: Salary of £55,000 to £70,000 depending on experience plus a bonus/commission structure, with eligibility for equity options at the end of your probation period.
Time off: 33 days' holiday (25 days plus 8 bank holidays), plus an extra day off for your birthday (or the nearest weekday).
Direct ownership: Take direct ownership of the most important deployments in the company, working closely with our founders and the team building the product.
Culture & connection: Enjoy regular socials, team trips, meals, and an annual company retreat.
Flexibility that works: Hybrid working from our Shoreditch office, with regular travel to NHS partner sites.

How To Apply

This role is urgent, so we are moving quickly. Please include your availability to start.

Application: Send us your profile, tell us why you are a great fit for this role, and confirm when you could start.
Screening: CV screening video call.
Case study: In-person presentation, so we can see how you think, communicate, and interact.
Culture fit: In-person conversation with a founder and members of the team.

new_jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic Partnerships
new_jobs.description:
Bitsight is a cyber risk management leader transforming how companies manage exposure, performance, and risk for themselves and their third parties. Companies rely on Bitsight to prioritize their cybersecurity investments, build greater trust within their ecosystem, and reduce their chances of financial loss.

Built on over a decade of technological innovation, its integrated solutions deliver value across enterprise security performance, digital supply chains, cyber insurance, and data analysis.

We invented the cyber ratings industry in 2011
Over 3500 customers trust Bitsight
Over 600 teammates are dispersed throughout Boston, Raleigh, New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and remote

About The Role

The Strategic Partnerships Customer Success Manager is a senior business operator with a strategic vision, responsible for owning the post-sale success, value adoption, expansion, and retention of Bitsight's most strategic customer accounts; including OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers), and Insurance use cases.

Unlike traditional CSM roles, this position emphasizes partner enablement, integration success, operational data scalability, and commercial alignment. You will serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the C-suite and executive leadership at partners who utilize, embed, resell, or operationalize Bitsight capabilities within their own offerings and service delivery models.

This is a role with significant strategic influence in our business. You will own a high-value portfolio (50-80 accounts), responsible for driving measurable success, deployment, adoption maturity, expansion revenue, and long-term retention. You will be accountable for improving net revenue retention, identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities, and positioning critical partnerships for predictable, scalable growth. Beyond your individual portfolio, you will shape and lead the strategic partnerships customer success function, mentor team members, and influence company-wide partner strategy.

This role is ideal for a person with sophisticated strategic judgment who combines deep technical and domain expertise with executive-level relationship management, commercial acumen, and organizational influence. You'll thrive at the intersection of customer success, strategic partnerships, solutions consulting, and revenue acceleration. You will have the autonomy to drive transformational partnerships and the future of how Bitsight scales with strategic partners. If you are hired near one of our offices, 3 days of in-office work is required, if not we also support hybrid/remote working models.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account & Revenue Leadership

Own post-sales success for a portfolio of the company's strategic and high-revenue OEM, and insurance customers, with direct accountability for NRR improvement, expansion revenue targets, and retention of critical accounts
Serve as the primary executive point of contact and trusted strategic advisor to the partner C-suite, executive leadership, product management, engineering, research and operations teams
Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year partner success strategies aligned to executive buyers business objectives, value realization metrics, competitive positioning, and growth targets
Own the qualification of expansion: identify, evangelize, structure, and partner with sales on high-value expansion opportunities including driven by signals such as; usage, new modules, adjacent solutions, vertical expansion, and strategic initiatives
Lead executive business reviews and strategic partnership planning sessions, presenting adoption metrics, value realization, competitive benchmarking, roadmap alignment, and renewal/expansion readiness to C-level executives. This role will require some travel to visit customers onsite.
Ensure consistent, predictable revenue retention and growth within the strategic partnership portfolio; drive partner satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS)

Strategic Partnerships & Organizational Leadership

Shape and evolve the customer success strategy and playbooks for strategic partnerships, establishing customer defined goals and maturity; best practices, frameworks, and scalable processes that other CSMs and teams can leverage
Mentor and develop CSMs and account management team members on strategic partnership management, executive engagement, and relationship dynamics
Serve as a voice of strategic partner customers within the organization; influence product roadmap, feature prioritization, business and technical strategy based on partner feedback and market positioning
Collaborate with the CRO, VP and Director of Customer Success to define KPIs, success metrics, and organizational priorities for the strategic partnerships segment
Contribute to cross-functional strategy sessions on partner ecosystem development, GTM alignment, and long-term partnership growth strategy

Partner Enablement & Integration

Align closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and Support teams to ensure seamless integration and implementation of Bitsight capabilities into partner platforms and workflows
Advise partners on API-based integrations, data feeds, platform configurations, and operational scalability requirements specific to their OEM, or insurance models
Develop best-practice guidance on value goals, maturity, workflows, SLAs, success metrics, and competitive positioning tied to Bitsight-powered offerings
Deliver partner-focused training, enablement content, digital touchpoints and certification programs for partner teams and personas
Serve as a liaison between partners and Bitsight technical teams, advocating for needs, identifying gaps, managing expectations and contributing to product roadmap alignment

Adoption & Value Realization

Conduct value discovery workshops to align capabilities with partner strategies, workflows, objectives, and models
Proactively monitor partner health signals, adoption milestones, NPS/CSAT, product usage trends, and time-to-value metrics to identify risk, drive adoption, and accelerate ROI
Guide partners through advanced product configuration, threat data operationalization, and integration decisions with their existing security infrastructure
Present adoption metrics, usage insights, and risk assessments to internal and external stakeholders, demonstrating platform effectiveness and value delivery
Identify expansion pathways across increased coverage, advanced modules, add-ons, and cross-sell opportunities within partner customer bases

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

Work with Sales to drive high renewal rates, expansion of ACV, and partnership customer business evolution
Lead risk mitigation strategies and renewal planning to ensure proactive engagement and strong expansion narratives
Contribute 10%+ of time to scalable CS processes and playbooks that support repeatable partner success and predictable revenue performance
Leverage operations tools (Claude, Gainsight, Salesforce, Pendo and related CS tooling) to deliver data-driven, scalable partner engagement
Champion the partner's voice internally, advocating for their needs and identifying systemic improvements to support partner growth

Requirements

Experience & Background

Proven track record managing large portfolios (80+ accounts) of enterprise, strategic, or high-revenue partner accounts with direct accountability for revenue retention, expansion, and NRR improvement
Direct experience supporting OEM, MSSP, ISV, platform, or integration-driven customers; experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, risk management, or insurance technology platforms is preferred
Demonstrated expertise building and managing complex, C-suite level relationships across matrixed organizations; proven ability to influence executive decision-making and drive strategic alignment
Experience leading or contributing to scalable CS strategy, process design, or organizational best practices; track record of mentoring and developing teams is a plus
Background in insurance software, managed services, platform distribution models, or enterprise security software is highly valued

Technical & Domain Expertise

Strong technical aptitude with practical understanding of APIs, integrations, data feeds, and complex platform configurations
Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts, threat intelligence workflows, managed detection and response (MDR), SIEM/SOAR platforms, or risk management frameworks
Experience advising on and supporting integrations across enterprise security ecosystems (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, EDR, GRC, ticketing systems, threat intelligence platforms)
Comfort operating in technically sophisticated environments; ability to engage confidently with security practitioners, architects, and CISOs

Business & Relationship Skills

Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills; ability to influence and align stakeholders at all organizational levels
Strong business acumen with ability to translate technical requirements into business outcomes and commercial value
Proven ability to identify, analyze, and articulate expansion opportunities; understand commercial models, licensing, and partner margin dynamics
Demonstrated project management excellence, including managing multiple concurrent complex engagements, timelines, and stakeholder expectations
Consulting mindset with proven problem-solving, analytical, and strategic thinking capabilities

Belonging & Inclusion
.
Bitsight is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, or status as an individual with a disability.

new_jobs.title: Associate Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Fullpath by Cox Automotive is a fast growing tech company in the automotive space with hubs across the US and Israel. We are disrupting the multi-trillion dollar transportation industry with our advanced Customer Data Platform (CDP) . Our work happens in the fast lane as we bring AI-powered, data-driven solutions to a quickly evolving industry.

Our team at Fullpath is made up of curious and creative individuals who are always looking to achieve the impossible. We are bold, collaborative, and goal driven, and, at our core, we believe every voice has value and can impact our bottom line.

If you are a creative, solutions oriented individual who is ready to put your career in drive, Fullpath is the place for you!

We’re looking for a driven, detail-oriented, and proactive Associate Customer Success Manager to support and scale our Customer Success efforts across enterprise accounts. In this role, you’ll play a key part in supporting campaign execution, managing operational workflows, solving problems, and partnering cross-functionally to drive results. You’ll work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where processes and priorities can evolve quickly, so the ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and find solutions without always having a defined path will be important. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is curious, eager to learn, comfortable taking on task-oriented work, and interested in building a long-term career in Customer Success with the potential to grow into a CSM role.

This is a remote position reporting to the Strategic Account Manager of Major Accounts.

What you will be responsible for:

Assisting the Customer Success team with the creation and execution of custom audience lists and campaigns, including digital advertising and email marketing campaigns.
Supporting the development and delivery of client-specific assets and reports, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Creating, customizing, and managing Dynamic Payments offers and other promotional materials as required.
Providing monthly support for co-op submissions.
Creating and managing inbound cases through a queue, ensuring requests are appropriately tracked and resolved.
Providing ongoing operational and task-based support for Fullpath’s Enterprise Customer Success team.
Collaborating cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure client requests and project deliverables are executed efficiently and to a high standard.
Supporting client communication when needed to fulfill assigned tasks and help ensure a positive customer experience.
Supporting strategic initiatives by helping manage project timelines, resources, and communications.
Monitoring and maintaining task workflows, escalating issues when needed and ensuring smooth handoffs within the Customer Success organization.
Identifying opportunities to improve existing processes, develop new workflows, and make day-to-day Customer Success operations more efficient.
Taking on additional account or customer support responsibilities as needed, including providing coverage when a CSM is unavailable.

Requirements:

Strong interest in building a career in Customer Success, with an interest in eventually growing into a Customer Success Manager role.
A proactive, curious, and self-directed approach to work, with a willingness to ask questions, learn independently, and find solutions when the path forward is not clearly defined.
Ability to operate effectively in an environment where processes, priorities, and responsibilities can change frequently.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of detailed, task-oriented work while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.
High level of competency working with data to support business decisions and customer outcomes.
Ability to build and implement follow-up processes and stay on top of multiple priorities.
Independent problem-solving skills and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with both internal teams and customers when needed.
Exposure to or interest in using AI tools to improve productivity, workflows, or day-to-day work.
Strong work ethic, ownership, and willingness to take on hands-on operational work as part of developing within Customer Success.
Automotive industry and/or digital advertising experience is a plus, but not required.
Legal authorization to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.
Ability to sit for extended periods and perform extensive computer work, both of which are key aspects of the role.
Ability to perform job duties from a home office, when applicable, utilizing necessary technology and maintaining productivity.
Regular, reliable attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the job to ensure consistent workflow and communication.

Why you should join us:

At Fullpath, we’re not just building groundbreaking AI—we’re redefining the dealership experience. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact while working alongside passionate, forward-thinking individuals who love what they do.

Competitive compensation & comprehensive benefits—because your well-being matters
Flexible, family-friendly environment that supports work-life balance
Global team of innovators, collaborators, and go-getters who challenge and uplift one another
Cutting-edge AI technology that delivers real value and solves complex challenges for our customers
Fast-paced startup culture with endless opportunities for learning, growth, and ownership
A culture built on feedback, initiative, and mutual success, where your voice is heard and your potential is nurtured

Join us in shaping the future of automotive retail—we’re just getting started.

Annual base salary: $65,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Benefits Options: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life/AD&D, EAP, 15 vacation days per year to start, 80 hours of sick leave, 12 paid holidays, paid parental leave, & 401k with company match.

In the meantime, you can get to know us a little better by checking out @lifeatfullpath on Instagram and Facebook .
